note: ui.manifest.build — chat/message block registry. One template per block group (events, social, blogging, form, payment, selection, list, messaging, miscellaneous, status, map); each /blocks/<group>/<name> page carries the registry item name (event-card, post-list, tag-select, …). 30 of 32 items attach; event-shared and manifest-types have no page. robots.txt allows /.
